title: Planetarium: A Rigorous Benchmark for Translating Text to Structured Planning Languages
reasoning: The paper presents a technical benchmark, 'Planetarium', for evaluating Large Language Models on their ability to generate PDDL code for automated planning. The domains evaluated (Blocks World, Gripper, and Floor Tile) are purely logical and technical in nature, with no components related to the evaluation of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
